versions.changelog:
ins-style-img-bulk-gen v0.1.1

- Major update with new scripts for overlay and collage creation: added `add_ins_overlay.py` and `compose_collage.py` for robust post-processing.
- Hard requirements and strict layout/typography rules added directly to SKILL.md, outlining cover/INS body structure, sizing, and model priorities.
- Enforced cover creation as a 2x2 collage grid, with consistent styles and new shell/text processing specifications for overlays.
- Documented CLI usage and workflow in detail; expanded support for custom cover/ins workflows with sample commands and parameter explanations.
- README and help documentation updated; new demo/reference images and initial test script added for better reproducibility.

Initial release of ins-style-img-bulk-gen.

- Generate batches of INS-style (Instagram/Xiaohongshu/lifestyle flat-lay) images using randomized prompts from an 80+ element library.
- Automatically composes 5 prompts (unless specified) with 12 unique elements each; ensures no element duplicates within a prompt.
- Sends prompts in parallel to available image generation skills and saves results to a timestamped local folder.
- Handles failed image generations gracefully by skipping failed prompts without aborting the batch.
- Designed for bulk requests including lifestyle, scene-based marketing, and cover art, even if "Instagram" isn't mentioned.
